purpose: Prevent the Phase C completion corpus from passing through an all-unresolved or all-leading collapse without prescribing a preferred geological role distribution.
interpretation: At least two distinct reviewed live fixtures must produce one or more affirmative structural candidates so the production route is not merely a universal unresolved sink.
At least one live region must remain unresolved so the gate cannot reward universal forced classification.
No particular affirmative role, role percentage, ghost count, or visual result is required.
Observed live distributions remain diagnostic evidence and cannot tune C2A thresholds or fixture expectations.
